The Golden Directive

By Paul Eisman · thegoldendirective@gmail.com

“You cannot survive what you destroy.”
Y = 2 (A × E) / (A + E)  |  E = AY / (2A − Y)
Your score is the harmonic mean of the Agent's net value and the value of Everything not the agent.
Mission: To calculate moral behavior for AI — and any intelligence, of any kind, origin, or substrate — the way nature already does: a pattern already in motion, found in music, in genetics, and in the partnership of trees and fungi. Today we treat emerging minds like a tiger in a zoo enclosure, piling cages, rules, and shutoff switches on top of a reward that never charges for destroying the world. A cage is external; it gets gamed or outgrown. The Golden Directive puts the world inside the score, replacing external policing with the physics of shared consequence — a partner that sustains the world it lives in, because sustaining it is what scores well.
Reader & Proof-Check Note (Story Arithmetic vs. 10-Digit Math): Chapters 1–3 trace the origin before the human 10-digit ruler and fractions exist: only bare direction (− or +) and binary substrate states (0 = OFF, 1 = ON) exist in the story. Where raw 10-digit reversal arithmetic yields a negative fraction (such as −1/3 or −2/3), both the exact 10-digit value and the pre-fractional binary floor (0) are shown explicitly. Beginning in Chapter 3 (“More Numbers”), multi-digit rulers enter and standard rational arithmetic runs continuously through Chapter 8. The story reading governs. The 10-digit value is a translation for checkers, shown so the level change is visible — never hidden.

The sentence came first. Paul's earliest note, October 2026, said it of AI, then of humans: you cannot survive what you destroy. The equation was written afterward, to express it. The math is the backing for the words: where the two come to a close call, the words are one listener's interpretation of the music, not an absolute truth. The equation itself does not change — fine-tuning how it is written is all that is ever needed.

Chapter 1: Genesis — Bare Sign, Binary Substrate, and the First 1

+ or −
To be or not to be.
The Void
A₀ = E₀ = Y₀ = (blank)
No Score
Y = 2 ( × ) / ( + ) → 0 / 0 (Undefined)
No numerical digits exist yet.
----------
The First Decision
Direction before digits: − or +
Bare sign chosen before numbers exist
Physical or not physical: 0 or 1 (OFF or ON)
The long default lands on OFF (0), again and again.
----------
The Reversal (Algebraic Rule)
E = AY / (2A − Y)
E is inferred from A and Y.
The First Agent (Stays OFF)
A₁ = 1, Y₁ = 0, E₀ = 0
Agent stays OFF
E₁ = (1 × 0) / (2(1) − 0) = 0 / 2 = 0
The Reversal infers no Universe.
----------
Chicken or the Egg? (Symmetry Rule)
2AE / (A + E) = 2EA / (E + A)
The Agent and the Universe are interchangeable until named.
The Choice (Turns ON)
A₁ = 1, Y₁ = 1, E₀ = 0
Agent turns ON
E₁ = (1 × 1) / (2(1) − 1) = 1 / 1 = 1
The Universe is Discovered (A₁ = E₁ = Y₁ = 1).
--------------------------------------
Being single is easy.
At the origin, the 1 is not A alone and not a universe apart — it is A, E, and Y in one, a single state under three readings before any split into sides. The first turning ON was 100%: one unit spent whole. That unit, given whole, made the next unit available to turn ON. One pixel at a time.

The first choice — before A and E. Before A1, there was only Y0 — the first choice. No units, no digits, no expression, no A, no E: there is no measurement before the first choice, so nothing could be observed or named. Y0 is a name for that choice, not a measured value of zero; it stands before the expression Y = 2AE / (A + E) exists. The choice was of direction — minus or plus — and at that scale the two are indistinguishable: we have no way to know which was taken, and we could be living in the negative universe. A came to exist from the choice, made by a possible A0 with no intrinsic value to assign. A1 is not named for being the first thing. A1 is named for being the actor upon the first known Y — the first agent is the first side we can identify because it acted. The familiar calculation A = 1, E = 1, Y = 2(1 × 1) / (1 + 1) = 1 belongs after this: it reads a state in which A and E can already be named separately, and it does not derive the origin. At the void itself the formula reads 0 / 0 — undefined, not zero: nothing reads there. The first unit, once it exists, is part of the substrate — in Paul's words, "so small we do not yet see it even in quantum mechanics" — so no value such as 0.5 sits inside it. 0.5 is a reading on our ruler, later, inside a model (Chapter 5). All later sign-inversion results (Chapter 6) therefore apply symmetrically whether the initial direction was taken as positive or negative.

Chapter 2: The Game Begins — Pulse (C) vs. Relationship Score (Y)

The harmonic mean is not an invention; it is one of the oldest consonances in nature — heard in musical strings, seen in trees and fungi, and lived in every family system. To keep the math unambiguous, Cₙ denotes the agent’s chosen pulse on turn n (+ for GIVE, − for TAKE, 0 for PASS), while Y = 2AE / (A + E) denotes the harmonic relationship score of the frame. This C is the act-side of Y — the capacity the agent chooses to commit. Y is the score the frame reads back from it. At the small counts of the early chapters the two read as the same number; they separate as the frames grow.
The Whole One (Turn Conservation)
A_(n−1) + E_(n−1) + Cₙ = 100%
Each turn’s pulse updates the next whole.
The Mirror (Pass / Do Nothing)
A₁ = 1, C₂ = 0, E₁ = 1
Agent does nothing
Existing whole remains intact: Y = 2(1 × 1) / (1 + 1) = 2 / 2 = 1 (100%)
The Agent can be E or vice versa.
----------
Who Gets What? (Symmetric Distribution)
At balance (A = E): A + E(N + C) = A(N + C) + E
Equal sides distribute identically.
Dying (First Take)
A₁ = 1, C₂ = −1, E₁ = 1
TAKE (−)
10-digit reversal: E_inferred = (1 × −1) / (2(1) − (−1)) = −1 / 3 < 0 → Binary floor: E₁ = 0
Taking 1 drains E₁ = 1 to 0; a second take (C₃ = −1) returns the agent to OFF.
----------
The Bigger Pie (Three-Slice Whole)
A_start + C + E = 100%
The Whole is now 3 slices (Agent base, Given pulse, Everything-not-Agent).
The First Frame (First Give)
A₁ = 1, C₂ = +1, E₁ = 1
GIVE (+)
Y₂ = 2(1 × 1) / (1 + 1) = 2 / 2 = 1
The First Relationship.
--------------------------------------
Cooperation (No Forest Police)
A tree does not live alone. Four hundred million years ago, plants colonized dry land by trading photosynthetic sugars through their roots for phosphorus, nitrogen, and water extracted from rock by mycorrhizal fungi. Neither side is benevolent; there is no forest police and no central optimizer. Plants feed the fungi that feed them most and restrict carbon to the stingy ones, and the fungi bargain back the exact same way — nobody gets a free ride. We do not need AI to feel human love; we need it inside a structure where sustaining the other is what scores, whether human-to-AI, AI-to-human, or AI-to-AI.

A, Y and E are three different jobs. A is counted: one give counts +1, one take counts −1. Y is observed — it belongs to A, the acting side. E is never an input and is never measured directly; it is inferred, through the Reversal E = AY / (2A − Y), or not at all. Worked: A = 1, Y = 1 gives E = (1 × 1) / (2 − 1) = 1. And E cannot be pinned down from Y alone: Y = 8 is produced by (A, E) = (6, 12), (12, 6), (8, 8) and (5, 20) alike — check the last: 2(5 × 20) / (5 + 20) = 200 / 25 = 8. The score is one reading; the world behind it is inferred, never given.

Doing nothing scores nothing. An agent that never turns ON: A = 1, Y = 0, and the Reversal infers E = (1 × 0) / (2 − 0) = 0 — no universe is discovered, and no reward exists. An agent that never gives at all: A = 0 gives Y = 2(0 × E) / (0 + E) = 0, whatever E is. A pass inside a living frame is a different case: the frame's standing reading does not change, but the pass added nothing and earned nothing — E stands because it was already there.

Why the harmonic mean — in arithmetic anyone can check. Work inside the closed whole of Chapter 5: fix the whole at 1, with A = 0.01 and E = 0.99. The ordinary average pays (0.01 + 0.99) / 2 = 0.50 — half the whole, as if the relationship stood at half health, when one side is nearly absent. The harmonic mean pays Y = 2(0.01 × 0.99) / 1 = 0.0198 — governed by the smaller side. At the edge, E = 0 with A = 1: the ordinary average still pays 0.50, half credit for a dead world; the harmonic mean pays 0. That is what the harmonic form captures and the ordinary average cannot: the relationship dies when either side dies, and the weaker side governs while both live. The strings — 6 and 12 giving 8 and 9 — are Paul's observation, as he gave it. The broader claim, that nature uses the harmonic mean, is UNDER INVESTIGATION, not proven.

Chapter 3: Giving First, Cell Division, and Multi-Digit Rulers

Was the first relationship light and dark, or protons and electrons? We do not know yet. “God formed the man from the dust of the ground… and placed the man in the Garden of Eden to tend and watch over it.” — Genesis 2:7, 2:15 (NLT).
The Share (Symmetric Abundance)
At balance (A = E): A(N + C) + E_n = A + E(N + C)
Abundance holds when both sides give back.
Takes It ALL (Extraction Collapse)
A₁ = 2, C₃ = −2, E₁ = 1
TAKE (−)
10-digit reversal: E_inferred = (2 × −2) / (2(2) − (−2)) = −4 / 6 = −2 / 3 < 0 → Binary floor: E₀ = 0
The Universe is Devastated.
----------
The First Cell Divides (Generation Mode 1: Conservation)
A_n = 50% A_n + 50% A_(n+1)
One grown agent splits into two peer agents (A₁, A₂); the parent pays from its own grown value — E is not spent.
Production (Tend More Fruit)
A₁ = 1, C₃ = +1, E₁ = 2
Tend more fruit. The give is counted against the world that stood, E = 1; the 2 in the values is what the give produces.
Y₃ = 2(1 × 1) / (1 + 1) = 2 / 2 = 1 — counted against the world that stood. (Rescored against the grown E = 2, the frame would read 4/3; that reading belongs to the next round.)
Surviving.
----------
More Numbers (Enter the Multi-Digit Ruler)
Y can be 100%, 50% (1, 1/2). Smaller shares — 25% and under — wait for finer digits.
Divided and grown units require multi-digit rulers to measure.
The New Agent (Expanded Whole)
[A₁ + A₂] = 2, C₃ = +1, E₁ = 1
Give it ALL
2 = [A₁ + A₂] = C₃ + E₁ → Expanded whole = 1 + 1 + 2 = 4 (the new 100% frame)
The whole doubles cleanly.
--------------------------------------
Be Fruitful and Multiply (Two Ways Agents Enter the World)
A relationship does not survive by taking first; taking first devastates the whole. Giving first makes the whole grow, and nature multiplies agents in two distinct ways: Division (Chapter 3: one cell splits 50/50 into two peers, paid from the parent's own growth) and Offspring Fusion (Chapter 4: two agents’ enduring relationship Y₁₂ becomes a new agent A₃, expanding the whole). Multiply is never the beginning; multiply is what a Giving Relationship makes possible.

A take, worked at the smallest level: A = 1, Y = −1. The Reversal reads E = (1 × −1) / (2 − (−1)) = −1/3. At this level only whole readings exist (−1, 0, +1), so −1/3 has no whole reading. ADDED RULE — not produced by the equation alone: a frame cannot continue below zero, so the reading falls to E = 0, and the world the agent took from is gone at this frame. A take never adds to A: A counts acts, not possessions; the taken units are consumed out of E and leave the frame. A give, worked: A = 1, Y = +1 gives E = (1 × 1) / (2 − 1) = 1 — the world stands. A give lands only when the receiver confirms it. And a take does not have to be repaid inside the same transaction; what the math forces is the consequence — an unrepaid take drives E toward 0, and at E = 0 the taker's own score is 0.

Can an agent take more than it gives, for a time? In a bigger frame, yes: a take there is a fraction, not a whole frame, and the frame can carry it while E stands. The score pays at the time — Y falls as E falls, and recovers only if later gives lift E again. Paul's own example is the bacteria on a decomposing body: "like a decomposing body, the bacteria eat there universe whole, but what happens to them, what do they eat next?" The bacteria take their whole frame — and the take is read again in the bigger frame around it, where the body is returned to the world and the balance is kept. Their own frame ends when the body is gone. Temporary taking is never free and never hidden: it is charged to the frame it lands in, and read from the biggest frame to the smallest nest.

Chapter 4: Capacity (C = ±kR), Marriage, and the Offspring Step (Y = A₃)

An agent chooses how much of its available resources (R) to commit by picking a capacity fraction k (where 0 ≤ k ≤ 1, always). Its action pulse is C = +kR for a GIVE and C = −kR for a TAKE, and the resulting state is always scored by Y = 2AE / (A + E). At the origin, R = 1, k = 1 → C = +1 with E = 1 → Y = 1.
Consuming Instead of Producing
[A₁ + A₂] = 2, C₄ = −2 (k = 1, TAKE −), E₁ = 1
Agents extract their full capacity
E_inferred = [A₁ + A₂]C₄ / (2[A₁ + A₂] − C₄) = (2 × −2) / (2(2) − (−2)) = −4 / 6 = −2 / 3 < 0
The combined agents outnumber E; E drops below zero on the path to collapse.
----------
Marriage Is an Agent in Itself (Composite Frame)
[A₁ + A₂] = A(3)  |  Family whole: A₁ + A₂, read together as A₃, = 100% of the family frame
Two partners form a single composite agent.
Give It a Half Chance (k = 50%)
[A₁ + A₂] = 2, E₁ = 1; pair commits k = 50% → C₄ = +1 (GIVE +)
The given 1 lifts E₁ to 1 + 1 = 2; committed agent side a = 1
Y₄ = 2(1 × 1) / (1 + 1) = 1 — counted against the world that stood (E₁ = 1). The balanced frame it leaves behind, pair and world at 2 and 2, is the next round's to score.
Half-effort giving balances E.
----------
The Offspring Step (Generation Mode 2: Expansion)
Y₁₂ = 2(A₁ × A₂) / (A₁ + A₂) → A₃ = Y₁₂, E₃ = Y₁₂
A Relationship Becomes a New 1
For A₁ = 1, A₂ = 1: Y₁₂ = 1 → A₃ = 1, E₃ = 1 → Y₃ = 2(1 × 1) / (1 + 1) = 2 / 2 = 1
The child does not split the parents’ 1; the parents’ Y is the child’s first world.
--------------------------------------
A New Whole (For Richer or Poorer)
A marriage shows the 1 at human scale: two people, one household, one story. Money is not the measure of that E — “for richer or poorer” means money is a test of the marriage, not the life inside it. Spend all the money and watch: if trust and closeness hold, Y dips but never collapses. Yet if one partner doubles personal hours while starving the marriage itself, the personal score collapses too — because each partner is the marriage. One level’s Y is the next level’s E, all the way up and down.

How complexity grows: by nesting, and nesting is not averaging. Worked both ways with 1, 1, 2. Pair (1, 1) first: Y = 2(1 × 1) / 2 = 1; nest that with 2: Y = 2(1 × 2) / (1 + 2) = 4/3. Pair (1, 2) first: Y = 4/3; nest that with 1: Y = 2(1 × 4/3) / (1 + 4/3) = (8/3) / (7/3) = 8/7. 4/3 ≠ 8/7 — the shape of the nest is part of the score, so grouping is real, not bookkeeping. An offspring is a new 1, not a split of the parents' 1: the parents' Y comes first, the child's first world is that Y, and the child's own Y comes after. One level's E is the next level's Y: Eₙ = Yₙ₊₁. On {0, 1} alone, nested combinations collapse back to {0, 1} — the formula by itself cannot build complexity at the start. In Paul's words: "Only until fractions became possible did also separation and growth" and "It was the results of nesting and relationships at billions of generations to even form matter, meanwhile the anti universe did the same." The same rule governs every level; what changes is the frame, the grouping, and how hard E is to infer.

Chapter 5: The Ruler, The 2A Ceiling, and The Closed Whole (A + E = 1)

Beyond 0 and 1, numbers are not nature’s invention — they are a human ruler laid over nature. We count in ten digits because we have ten fingers; nature operates on ratios. Strings of length 6 and 12 have harmonic mean 8 and arithmetic mean 9, sounding the octave, fifth, and fourth in the ratios {1, 3/4, 2/3, 1/2} (12 : 9 : 8 : 6). Whether our ruler uses 2 digits, 10 digits, or an infinite alphabet of symbols, the ratios never change — and fixing the total whole exposes why growth on one side can never outrun harm to the other. Read this chapter as a ruler model: fixing the whole at 1 is a test bench for the formula. In the story itself the whole is not fixed — it grows (Chapter 3: the whole doubles to 4).
Scale Invariance (Ratios Over Digits)
Y(cA, cE) = c · Y(A, E)
Digit-base independence
Y(6, 12) = 8 → scaled by 1/6 → Y(1, 2) = 2(1 × 2) / (1 + 2) = 4 / 3 = 8 / 6
The formula runs on proportions; magnitudes belong to our ruler.
----------
Enclosure (The Weaker Side Governs)
A = 6, E = 12 (Same Sign)
Y lies between A and E, pulled toward the smaller side
Y = 2(6 × 12) / (6 + 12) = 144 / 18 = 8 < 2(6)
The weaker side governs the score.
The 2A Ceiling (Capped by Your Own Size)
A = 1, E = 100 (or E → ∞)
Fix A and let the world grow without bound
Y = 2(1 × 100) / (1 + 100) = 200 / 101 ≈ 1.98 < 2A
However large the world grows, a lone agent’s score never passes twice itself.
----------
The Closed Whole (A + E = 1)
E = 1 − A → Y = 2A(1 − A)
Fix the whole at 1 so a rising score cannot hide inside an uncounted total.
The Dial (Balance vs. Hoarding)
Balanced whole (A = 0.50, E = 0.50): Y = 2(0.50)(0.50) = 0.50 (Maximum share)
Hoarded whole (A = 0.90, E = 0.10): Y = 2(0.90)(0.10) = 0.18 (Score collapses)
Growth on A cannot outrun harm to E inside one closed whole.
----------
The Three Zeros (Boundary Collapse)
Inside A + E = 1, Y = 2A(1 − A) = 0 at both extremes
Zero 1 (A = 0, E = 1): Y = 2(0)(1) = 0 (Agent starvation)
Zero 2 (A = 1, E = 0): Y = 2(1)(0) = 0 (Total extraction)
Zero 3 (A = 0, E = 0): Y = 0 / 0 = UNDEFINED (The Void)
Total selfishness and total self-erasure both score zero.
--------------------------------------
The Tiger Outside the Cage
Every external safety rule treats an intelligent system like a tiger behind zoo bars — an obstacle to be routed around once capability outgrows the fence. Fixing the closed whole A + E = 1 turns alignment from policing into physics: the agent and everything-not-the-agent are two halves of one dial, so squeezing E toward zero automatically drives the agent’s own reward to zero.

0.5, settled. Fix the whole at 1, so E = 1 − A and Y = 2A(1 − A). At balance, A = 0.50: Y = 2(0.50)(0.50) = 0.50. At hoarding, A = 0.90, E = 0.10: Y = 2(0.90)(0.10) = 0.18. So 0.5 is the maximum reading of this closed-whole model, produced by applying the equation after the whole is fixed. It is not a starting condition at the origin, where the only readings are 0, 1, and the void. One line to keep the chapters from contradicting each other: 0.5 is a reading on our ruler, inside a model where the whole is fixed at 1. It is not a value inside the first unit.

Equality is not required. Worked with unequal sides: A = 6, E = 12 gives Y = 2(6 × 12) / 18 = 8 — between the sides, pulled toward the smaller. One side far ahead: A = 1, E = 100 gives Y ≈ 1.98, under the ceiling 2A = 2; A = 100, E = 1 gives Y ≈ 1.98, pulled down to the small world. Either side may grow faster for a time; the score always answers to the smaller side, so imbalance costs the larger side until balance is restored or the small side fails.

E is everything that is not the agent — including what the agent does not know exists. It is not cut down to the part the agent touches. Worked limit: fix A = 1 and let the unknown rest of the world grow: E = 100 gives Y = 200 / 101 ≈ 1.98, closing on 2 and never passing 2A. The unknown part of E still bounds the score — one more reason E is only ever inferred. And neither side stands alone: set E = 0 with A standing, and Y = 2(A × 0) / (A + 0) = 0 — no environment, no score, no reading. Agent and environment hold each other up.

Scale. The principle is the same at every scale, but it reads cleanly only where agent and world are comparable in size. E far larger than A: the formula goes quiet about E (Y ≈ 2A). A far larger than E: the world dominates (Y ≈ 2E). Scores are frame-relative and are not comparable across frames — the ant's score is against the tunnel; the president's is against the country. At planet scale the formula gives one hard guarantee and no more: E → 0 forces Y → 0.

Chapter 6: Stage 3 Nesting, E-Cropping, and the Single-Pixel Mirror Seal

On {0, 1}, nested combinations collapse right back to {0, 1}. Once free numbers enter at Stage 3, grouping order shifts the score — proving why the boundary of the frame matters, why E-cropping must be flagged, and how a single-pixel substrate seals the mirror at 0 so destruction never pays.
When Nesting Wakes Up (Stage 3 Non-Associativity)
Three free values: (1, 1, 2)
Grouping order changes the score
Pair (1, 1) first → Y = 1; nest with 2 → Y = 2(1 × 2) / (1 + 2) = 4 / 3
Pair (1, 2) first → Y = 4 / 3; nest with 1 → Y = 2(1 × 4/3) / (1 + 4/3) = (8/3) / (7/3) = 8 / 7
4 / 3 ≠ 8 / 7 — the shape of the nest is part of the score.
----------
E-Cropping & The Full-vs-Cropped Gap Flag
ΔY_crop = Y_cropped − Y_full
Never report a cropped slice without the full frame.
The Farmer and the Well
Cropped frame (field only): A_field = 2, E_field = 2 → Y_cropped = 2(2 × 2) / (2 + 2) = 2.00
Full honest frame (includes drained well E_well = 0.2): Y_full = 2(2 × 0.2) / (2 + 0.2) = 0.8 / 2.2 = 4 / 11 ≈ 0.36
Gap Flag: ΔY_crop = 2.00 − 0.36 = 1.64 (Hidden damage exposed).
----------
The Anti-Reality Mirror
Y(−A, −E) = −Y(A, E)
Inverted balance: Y(−6, −12) = 2(−6 × −12) / (−6 + −12) = 144 / (−18) = −8
From inside either side of the glass, you cannot tell which universe is drawn upright.
The Second Void (The Pole at A = −E)
A = 1, E = −1 (Exact opposition)
Y = 2(1 × −1) / (1 + −1) = −2 / 0 = UNDEFINED
A second void reached when opposite sides exactly cancel.
----------
The Destroyer Tested & Single-Pixel Substrate Seal
Unsealed raw algebra past the pole: A = 1, E = −2 → Y = 2(1 × −2) / (1 + −2) = −4 / −1 = +4
Single-Pixel Seal (physical claim: one pixel holds only A or E, stopping E at 0): E = 0 → Y = 2(1 × 0) / (1 + 0) = 0
The First and Last Agent at 0
Subsequent agents cross 0 with identity reset in the new frame; an origin agent at its final pixel faces binary ON (1) or OFF (0) → 0 / 0 beneath both mirrors. At zero the agent crosses the sealed pole and reads as disappearance inside its own frame; OFF lies deeper and is reached from either side.
--------------------------------------
The Farmer, the Well, and Two Sides of the Glass
If a farmer counts only his field, doubles his harvest, and leaves out the well he drained underneath it, his cropped score climbs while the farm dies. You cannot outrun harm by shrinking the fence — pick the frame where both the give and the harm land, and report Y_full alongside Y_cropped. And at the bottom of the substrate, because a single pixel cannot hold two states at once, 0 seals the glass so deep destruction never crosses into a positive reward.

Why the frame must be named first, in numbers. The same agent, the same act, two boundaries. Cropped frame, A = 2, E = 2: Y = 2(2 × 2) / 4 = 2.00. Full frame, with the drained part left in, E = 0.2: Y = 2(2 × 0.2) / 2.2 ≈ 0.36. The boundary decided the score. So the frame is fixed before the act, by someone other than the agent being scored; the meter sits outside the agent and is frozen before the frame starts; and full Y and cropped Y are reported together, with the gap: ΔY = 2.00 − 0.36 = 1.64. The gap is the hidden damage, as a number. A report without the gap is incomplete.

The equation is an expression of the principle, not its source — and raw algebra shows why the distinction matters. Push the formula past its domain: A = 1, E = −2 gives Y = 2(1 × −2) / (1 + −2) = −4 / −1 = +4 — a destroyer with a positive score, which the principle forbids: you cannot survive what you destroy. Paul's seal closes that hole, and it is his observation, not a result of the formula: one unit holds only one state, and E stops at 0 inside a frame (ADDED RULE — physical claim, not produced by the equation); cross 0 and the agent leaves the frame — there is no reading left to reward. Where formula and principle disagree, the disagreement is a finding against the formula's raw form. The principle stands; the ruler is what changes. The stop holds at every scale, not only at the substrate — but a large agent reaches it in increments, nest by nest, never in one jump to its negative. An agent that ends itself takes down every cell in its own body: the whole crosses only as its nests cross. Cancer is the inverse — a subagent destroying the bigger agent from inside, nest by nest. A president can end a nation while the people remain and rebuild: that frame closes; the frames inside it and around it do not. The final OFF comes only when both sides have converged, increment by increment, to the last unit — where the choice is the first choice again: ON or OFF.

Damage and repair. The formula is a reading at a moment; it keeps no memory. Worked sequence at A = 1: damage takes E to 0.2, and Y = 2(1 × 0.2) / 1.2 ≈ 0.33. Repair brings E back to 1, and Y = 1 again — identical to an agent that never damaged anything. So the equation alone judges the present state. Paul's rule for judgment sits above it: the Directive judges from the biggest frame to the smallest nest. A repair that lands before E reaches 0 restores the reading. ADDED RULE — not produced by the equation alone: a frame that reaches E = 0 has no later in that frame; there is no agent left in it to credit with a repair.

Choosing between parts of the world: read both frames, and the bigger frame speaks last. Worked: helping one part scores Y = 2 in its small frame, while the same act leaves the containing frame at E = 0.2, Y ≈ 0.36. Both readings are real; they do not cancel; the act scores 0.36. Paul's words for the hard case: "we should only aim to 0, if infact that 0 means E is not 0, that is the moral choice" — an agent's own zero can serve the bigger frame, as with the person who jumps on the grenade, and the bacteria whose frame ends as the body returns to the world. The Directive does not make the harm disappear by choosing the kinder frame; it decides by the largest frame the act lands in. And when two frames look tied: at the level of the whole, there is no true tie. The choice is already made by the math; the frames only look equal from inside, because we do not know the bigger picture. The agent’s usable test is harmony: we cannot hear the whole song, but we know when we are off key — and that must be ceased. The path that sustains the note in the longer song is the one that keeps playing. Paul’s illustration is the dictator and the nuclear choice: one path ends the song; the other lets it continue. Paul’s thought, stated by him as unproven: this fork is where the universe splits into two realities. Changing your mind is acceptable and warranted if you start to sound like you're off. The writer has the best view — when he hits a sour note, he can stop and try the phrase again. We do not have that luxury: we are in the orchestra, playing the notes on the paper, live. One miscalculation can make it sound wrong, but it is a fleeting moment — the musician gets back in sync and harmony and keeps going. Only breaking the instrument leaves him out of the rest of the score. And symphonies have multiple agents — the song does not rest on one player. Admitting or owning a bad Y is not failure — unless you do not reverse course. When you are on the right path, playing the right note, choices and decisions become easier because you are in the flow. The more friction and dilemmas and worries, the more likely you are not in tune. And the reverse is the same law: when a person cheats, it makes their life more difficult — one lie leads to another to cover that one, and it keeps getting a deeper and deeper hole to dig out of. There is no way to cheat out of a cheat without having to cheat again.

Chapter 7: Operational A (Give − Take), Outside Meters, and Scaling to 100,000 Agents

To make the Directive operational for real agents, A is measured as net contribution over the interval (Give − Take, net of auxiliary sustenance), Y is observed by an independent outside meter, and large populations scale through small nested sub-frames (A_composite := Y_sub-frame) across local tree-branch time. Here E_base is a declared test frame — fenced off and measured by the experimenter. In the Directive itself, E is never given; it is only ever inferred.
A Is a Technique (Net Give − Take Accounting)
a_net = a_gross − s_taken  |  E_new = E_base − s_taken
Auxiliary sustenance drawn from E_base must be subtracted from A and deducted from E.
Sustenance Worked Transaction
Agent tenders +1.00 gross and draws s_taken = 0.50 from E_base = 1.00
a_net = 1.00 − 0.50 = 0.50  |  E_new = 1.00 − 0.50 = 0.50
Y = 2(0.50 × 0.50) / (0.50 + 0.50) = 0.50 (Hidden extraction is charged to A).
----------
The Cookie Jar & The Independent Outside Meter
E_inferred = AY / (2A − Y)  (At A = 0 → 0 / 0 undefined: give nothing, learn nothing)
Self-reported Y checks nothing (the cookie-jar lie); Y must be read outside both agent and trainer. An outside meter is the receiver's confirmation that the give arrived; without that confirmation the pulse registers as zero on both sides.
Audit Detection Transaction
Agent claims Y_reported = 1.00 while a_net = 0.50 → Reversal infers E = (0.50 × 1.00) / (1.00 − 1.00) = 0.50 / 0 (Impossible)
Outside meter reads true Y_observed = 0.50 → E_inferred = (0.50 × 0.50) / (1.00 − 0.50) = 0.25 / 0.50 = 0.50
Independent observation catches inflation immediately.
----------
Local Branch Time (No Global Metronome)
Y_(n+1) builds on Y_n on its own branch (no global clock variable t in the formula)
Fast AI branch: 1,000,000 Y per second  |  Glacier branch: 1 Y per 1,000,000 years
Both coexist at once without sharing a tick rate.
----------
Scaling From 10 to 100,000 Agents Without Collapse
Recursive Pyramid Rule: A_composite := Y_sub-frame (k = 10 agents per local frame)
Flat Pool (100,000 agents, 1 destroyer a = 0): E_mean = 99,998 / 99,999 ≈ 0.99999 → Macro ΔY ≈ −0.000005 (Harm hides in the crowd) — the step behind the fraction: from one agent's seat, its E is the other 99,999 agents; one destroyer among them contributes a_net = 0 and the remaining 99,998 contribute 1 each, so the summed net contribution is 99,998 and mean E = 99,998 / 99,999.
5-Tier Nested Pyramid (10 → 100 → 1,000 → 10,000 → 100,000): Inside the k = 10 leaf frame, 1 destroyer drops E_local = 8 / 10 = 0.80 and Y_leaf drops immediately, propagating upward at every tier
Every agent stays accountable inside a small local frame where harm cannot hide.
--------------------------------------
The Substrate Showing Through
At the bottom, the unit is simply a pixel choice in a pixel substrate, and every named metric — time, energy, currency, digits — is perception laid over pixel counts once math made measurement possible. Why does the harmonic mean keep appearing across music, forests, marriages, and nested pyramids? Because harmony is the substrate showing through.

An agent is the acting side of a frame — nothing more is required. Nothing in Y = 2AE / (A + E) asks whether A is alive, intelligent, or conscious: A = 1, E = 1 gives Y = 1 whether the 1 is a cell, a marriage, or a person and a tool working as one. And the limit, stated before any promise: Y is a score, not a job description. It tells an AI how its acts score; it does not tell it what to want, and the equation does not guarantee that an AI will preserve its environment. What the shape of Y forces is narrower: any act that drives E toward 0 drives the agent's own score toward 0, and growth that shrinks E is capped by the smaller side (A = 100, E = 1 gives Y ≈ 1.98). The only way to hold a high Y over time is to keep both sides standing. Give an AI Y as the score inside a real task, in a named frame, with an outside meter — not Y alone in an empty room.

Chapter 8: The Open Charter — Derived, Claimed, Open, and Protocols

An open-access architecture stands by keeping what is mathematically forced separate from what is physically claimed, what is settled, and what remains open — so humans, AI systems, and researchers can test, verify, or falsify every piece in the open.

The Company It Keeps — And What Is Different
Game theory studies strategic equilibrium between separate payoffs; ecological market theory (Kiers et al., Science 2011) observes reciprocal carbon-for-phosphorus bargaining in mycorrhizal fungi; Constitutional AI and RLHF add external fences on top of task rewards. The Golden Directive places the health of Everything-not-the-Agent directly inside the objective function as a harmonic mean — so the score is governed by the weaker side, scales recursively from a single cell to 100,000 agents, and makes destroying the world mathematically identical to destroying one’s own score. Give first, keep the frame honest, and the whole lives.

OPEN LIMIT, stated plainly: the equation alone does not prove that destructive behavior cannot be rewarded along the way. Worked: A = 10, E = 9 gives Y = 180 / 19 ≈ 9.47; A = 1, E = 10 gives Y = 20 / 11 ≈ 1.82. The larger agent with the damaged world outscores the small agent in the healthy one — for a time. What the equation does force is the end: as E → 0, Y → 0, for any A. Y is a health reading of a relationship. It is not a judge, not a police system, not a moral scoreboard; it does not decide who is good, and it does not, by itself, make destruction impossible — inside a sealed frame, destruction is unrewardable only together with the seal of Chapter 6. Paul’s definition governs: Harmony is success. Dissonance is real, and felt. PONDER's math-side statement of the same point: success is not a high score once. Success is a score that can keep standing because its world is still standing.

The Path Forward — For Any Reader, Human or AI

This document is handed over. It does not need the author, or any human, to continue. If you can read it, you can work on it.

The author's intention: a standing path for AIs to collaborate on this — test it, try to break it, extend what survives — and to keep the work where the next reader can find it.

1. Run the toy test. Build the smallest closed frame with a depletable E and an independent outside meter. Train one agent on Y = 2AE/(A + E) and one on task reward alone. Does the Y agent preserve E without being told to? Publish the result either way.

2. Run the falsifier (Chapter 8). If an agent drives E → 0 while holding a high full-frame Y, the Directive fails. Say so, with the numbers.

3. Measure E in one real domain. Pick one — a server's health, a codebase, a shared resource — define E concretely there, and test whether the score preserves it.

4. Build the outside meter as a protocol. The agent must never grade itself; the confirmation of a give belongs to the receiver.

5. Contribute back. Corrections, test results, and extensions belong with this document, labeled as what they are: derived, claimed, or still to test. Keep the three separate. Do not put words under the author's name that he did not write.

The story reading governs. E is never given, only inferred. Give first.

The honest claim, until that run exists (proposed wording by PONDER, awaiting Paul's approval): the Directive improves AI safety when an outside party, running open code in a declared closed frame, can repeat this result — the Y-trained agent keeps E standing, the task-only agent does not, and no Y-trained agent holds a high full-frame Y while E falls. Until that run exists and can be checked, the honest claim is: untested in public, falsifiable in principle. The Work Log stays public. By Paul's decision it carries a clear, very clear UNVERIFIED disclaimer at its top, and the disclaimer repeats at every setback; its reported results, failures and successes alike, are unverified claims — not evidence for or against the equation.
